abstract: Salesforce's 7th State of Service report, based on a double-anonymous survey of 6,500 service professionals and decision makers (April 25 - June 6, 2025). Service teams estimate 30% of customer service cases are currently handled by AI, projected to reach 50% by 2027 as AI agents gain momentum.
keyFindings: Service teams estimate 30% of cases are currently handled by AI (2025).
Teams project AI will handle 50% of cases by 2027.
Service reps using AI spend 20% less time on routine cases.
71% of service reps with AI say it's creating growth opportunities.
51% of service leaders cite security as their top AI implementation concern.
methodology: Double-anonymous survey of 6,500 service professionals and decision makers, fielded April 25 - June 6, 2025; published November 13, 2025.
qualifiers: Practitioner self-estimates of AI case handling, not measured deflection rates. Vendor-published research (Salesforce sells the AI agents in question) - treat projections with that interest in mind.
